card.name: Last digit of phone and ZIP numbers
card.fires_on: The final digit of a long contact number, such as the last digit of a phone number or ZIP+4 code, in contact or address details.

modes.label: Phone number ending
modes.description: Last digit of a phone number after 'call' or 'contact'.

modes.label: ZIP+4 ending
modes.description: Last digit of a ZIP+4 code in a mailing address.

card.plain: It fires on the last digit of a phone number or ZIP+4 code in contact details.
